results.title: Ledger invariants after all injected failures
20 trials: two farmers' threads allocate 80 each from one 100 kg lot to DIFFERENT requests
results.expected: at most one allocation per trial; available never negative
results.actual: both succeeded in 0/20 trials; negative availability in 0/20 (e.g. [])
results.notes: Finding F-01 if failing: the availability read uses a REPEATABLE READ snapshot taken before the lot lock.

results.title: Deterministic interleaving: A reads ownership (snapshot), B allocates 80 and commits, A continues
results.expected: A rejected 'Not enough stock'; lot available 20
results.actual: A=Not enough stock. Lot #54 has only 20 kg available., B=ok; lot 100/80/20
results.notes: The pause only widens a timing window that exists in normal scheduling; no SQL is changed.
